what: A full-bleed photo panel pinned to the screen shrinks into a tilted postcard, tied directly to scroll (no curve) while the marker row (one screen height) rises from the bottom of the screen to the top. Width and height shrink directly from screen size to 32.8125×29.0625rem (tablet 22.4×25.3 · phone 13.5×15.2), not by scale, so text inside the panel and the paper margins keep their size. The panel tilts −5° and floats from screen center up by 10% of screen height (tablet 0 · phone 5% down). The text block over the panel is pushed out by the same progress, beyond 120vw left and right on wide screens and below 100vh under 991px. Lay a paper frame behind the panel (wider than the panel and longer at the bottom) and the photo becomes a postcard, revealing the next section behind it

options.w · h: Reduced board width and height on wide screens (rem), default 32.8125 · 29.0625
options.tilt: Tilt when fully shrunk (deg), default −5 — 0 means straight
options.lift · lift-md · lift-sm: Share lowered further from center when fully shrunk (screen height %), default −10 · 0 · 5
options.away: Distance the text block is pushed away (vw), default 120
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Panel (child) that sticks to the screen and shrinks — pinned with sticky, centered horizontally
options.[data-fx-part=marker]: Progress bar line (child) — one screen height, goes 0 → 1 while this line’s top edge moves from screen bottom → top
options.[data-fx-part=away]: Text block that gets pushed along (grandchild inside the panel) — data-dir="-1" means left, 1 means right
options.--fx-p: Outputs progress 0~1 to the section — for moving other things on the panel together

use: Select
note: The panel height is set to the screen height and stuck inside the section with sticky, so the section must be taller than the panel (the original is a 600vh section whose fifth screen height is the indicator row). The original writes the panel’s inline transform directly on every scroll event — same formula

from.where: index.html .sn-choose (after the preset-picking circular transition ends, over five screen heights the photo panel shrinks into a postcard and the title·name·dial slide out left and right, revealing the ‹Preset› section behind)
